query: Does the World Bank Pink Sheet (CMO Historical Data Monthly Excel file) contain a 'Sulphur (Tampa)' price series in USD/metric ton, as of mid-2026? Inspect the actual column headers in the official CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx fertilizer group (Phosphate rock, DAP, TSP, Urea, Potassium chloride) to confirm whether a Sulphur/Sulfur column exists. If the series exists, what are its reported monthly values for Jan-Jun 2026?
answer:
I have completed the research and delivered both the full markdown synthesis and the structured findings.

## Bottom Line

**No — the World Bank Pink Sheet does NOT contain a 'Sulphur (Tampa)' price series** (or any Sulphur/Sulfur commodity price in USD/metric ton) as of mid-2026.

I verified this directly against the official **June 2026 Pink Sheet** (dated June 2, 2026), which is generated from the same dataset as CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx. The complete **Fertilizers group** contains exactly five series, all in $/mt:
- DAP
- Phosphate rock
- Potassium chloride
- TSP
- Urea (E. Europe)

There is **no Sulphur/Sulfur row**. The only occurrence of "sulfur" in the entire document is a quality specification ("sulfur less than 1%") in the *Coal (South Africa)* description — not a priced commodity.

**Key clarification:** "Sulphur (Tampa)" is a real fertilizer-industry benchmark, but it's published by **Argus, CRU, Bloomberg Green Markets, and Profercy** — not the World Bank. It should not be expected in the CMO dataset. Since the series doesn't exist, there are no Jan–Jun 2026 sulphur values to report.

Sources:
- [CMO Pink Sheet June 2026 (PDF)](https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/74e8be41ceb20fa0da750cda2f6b9e4e-0050012026/related/CMO-Pink-Sheet-June-2026.pdf)
- [CMO Historical Data Monthly (xlsx)](https://thedocs.worldbank.org/en/doc/5d903e848db1d1b83e0ec8f744e55570-0350012021/related/CMO-Historical-Data-Monthly.xlsx)
